edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/arch/x86/mm/pat/set_memory.c
+++ /linux/arch/x86/mm/pat/set_memory.c
@@ -449 +449,11 @@
-	end =   fix_addr(__cpa_addr(cpa, cpa->numpages));
+	/*
+	 * Addresses in an array are not guaranteed to be contiguous
+	 * or ordered. Computing a range for them using the last element
+	 * is unreliable and the element at index numpages is out of bounds.
+	 * Force a full flush for arrays.
+	 */
+	if (cpa->flags & (CPA_PAGES_ARRAY | CPA_ARRAY))
+		end = TLB_FLUSH_ALL;
+	else
+		end = fix_addr(__cpa_addr(cpa, cpa->numpages));
+
